subject: Private offer — ancillary fees, reseller crediting, and invoice routing
messages:
From: Shannon Park <procurement@ascendai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer: ancillary fees + invoice routing

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the call earlier. As we start to scope the AWS private offer for AscendAI, procurement has a few open items before we route the PO to finance:

1) Invoice path: AscendAI prefers the reseller to invoice us directly (partner invoices AscendAI) rather than list-price passback through the marketplace due to our accounting rules. Can Redwood support reseller-invoiced private offers and still keep the private offer pricing intact?

2) Ancillary fees: we see marketplace listing and processing fees in some proposals — can you confirm what would be charged to us vs retained by the reseller?

3) Trailing commissions / clawback: our channel model requires a 90–180 day clawback window for partner commissions on early churn. We need to know if Redwood can support trailing commissions and a clawback schedule so we can align reseller contracts.

Attaching a draft SOW (AscendAI_SOW_v1.pdf) for context and the procurement intake form. Targeting a signature by end of month if terms align.

Can you confirm the options and next steps?

Thanks,
Shannon Park
Procurement Manager
AscendAI

Attachment: AscendAI_SOW_v1.pdf (stub)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Shannon Park <procurement@ascendai.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer: ancillary fees + invoice routing

Hi Shannon —

Appreciate the SOW and the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then a recommended path:

- Reseller-invoiced private offers: yes, we support partner invoicing for private offers. Two routes:
  A) Reseller invoices AscendAI directly and Redwood honors the private-offer pricing via a backend reconciliation with the reseller (recommended for AscendAI accounting needs).
  B) Deal is issued via marketplace but reseller receives a passback credit — creates more accounting work on your side.

- Ancillary fees: marketplace listing/processing is typically a small percentage retained by the marketplace or reseller depending on the markdown contract. If route A above is chosen, Redwood can zero out marketplace pass-through fees on the customer invoice; reseller/reseller-agency may retain a negotiated commission. We can provide a line-item split for invoice.

- Trailing commissions and clawback: we can configure a trailing commission schedule and a clawback window. Typical defaults are 90 days for SaaS ARR churn; 180 days is also doable but needs explicit reseller agreement.

Recommended next steps:
1) Camila (cc) — can you prepare two invoice-path options (A vs B) with estimated fee splits and a short example invoice for AscendAI?
2) Ben (cc) — can finance/legal confirm clawback language and whether Redwood needs a contra account or escrow for partner returns?
3) Shannon — if you can return the procurement form with payment terms (Net30/Net60) and confirm preferred invoice path, we’ll assemble a private-offer package and push terms to legal.

I’ll include our draft private-offer T&Cs for transparency once finance confirms.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Cloud Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: Shannon Park <procurement@ascendai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ascendai.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer: ancillary fees + invoice routing

Connor —

Thanks — option A (reseller invoices us) is strongly preferred. A couple more specifics from procurement:

- Payment terms: AscendAI requests Net60. Please confirm if Redwood/reseller accept Net60.
- Clawback: we prefer 180-day clawback for partner commissions on any committed reserved capacity; can Redwood/partner accommodate 180 days (we can accept a taper schedule if full 180 is a blocker).
- Commission rate: the reseller is proposing a 6% trail on committed revenue. We need confirmation that the reseller can be set up to receive that trail and that any clawback will be applied to reseller payouts, not customer invoices.

Attaching our procurement form for signatures (AscendAI_Procurement_Form.xlsx). If we can get a firm invoice path + DocuSign-ready terms and a sample invoice by next Tue (21 July), procurement will route the PO the same day.

Shannon Park
Procurement Manager, AscendAI
Attachment: AscendAI_Procurement_Form.xlsx (stub)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Shannon Park <procurement@ascendai.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer: ancillary fees + invoice routing

Hi Shannon —

Thanks for the clarity and the procurement form. Summary of how we can support Option A (reseller invoices AscendAI) and the proposed commercial mechanics:

1) Invoice routing (Option A - supported): reseller invoices AscendAI directly. Redwood will record the private-offer discounted SKU and reconcile gross-to-net with the reseller through a monthly settlement. Customer invoice will show Redwood product line items; reseller commission and any marketplace fees will be accounted for on the reseller settlement, not on the customer invoice.

2) Ancillary fees: we propose the following split (example):
   - Marketplace listing/processing fee: 0% charged to AscendAI (absorbed by reseller or Redwood per resellers' preference).
   - Transaction processing fee (if any): passed to AscendAI only if explicitly agreed; default is Redwood covers for Strategic Enterprise private offers.

3) Commission & clawback:
   - Reseller commission: 6% trail on committed revenue (as requested).
   - Clawback: 180-day clawback on reseller payouts is supported. We recommend a tapered clawback schedule: 100% recoverable within 0–90 days, 50% recoverable 91–180 days. This reduces the cash burden on the reseller while protecting AscendAI.

4) Payment terms: Redwood can accept Net60 via reseller invoice, subject to reseller acceptance. For the private-offer contract between Redwood and AscendAI, payment terms remain Net30 by default; the reseller-customer invoice can be Net60. We will document both paths in the DocuSign packet so procurement has the ledger clarity they need.

Attachments: Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms-v2.pdf (stub) — includes sample invoice template and settlement cadence.

Next steps:
- Connor: assemble the DocuSign packet (private-offer T&Cs + sample invoice + settlement schedule) and send to Shannon by EOD Wed 21 Jul.
- Laura / Finance (cc): please review the tapered clawback proposal and confirm settlement cadence (monthly) and how we show contra entries for reconciliations.

Shannon — once you confirm reseller acceptance and Net60 on their invoice, we will generate the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
